payload.text: WP13's parity record, its contacts and mail rows (AC-00.5). hv's run 1 compared nothing: both sides refused Contacts (exit 3), and the legacy's email lacked mail-recent (the runner cleared PPLR_MAIL_RECENT; fixed and proved on synthetic data). Released when hv has run parity/hv-next.zsh and pasted its lines; then cc classifies the rows into WP13's body and deletes the outputs. If Contacts reads authorized plainly but not inside sandbox-exec, the contacts rows also wait for vc's ruling on their write guard.
